```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggtext)

theme_set(theme_bw() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))

params <- read_csv('../full_output/parameters/test_design.csv')

case_counts <- lapply(list.files('../full_output/case_counts', full.names = TRUE), function(x){
  read_csv(x) %>% mutate(sim_id = gsub('../full_output/case_counts/|_binned_case_counts.csv', '', x))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# example trees
trees <- lapply(list.files('../full_output/trees/', full.names = TRUE, pattern = 'r0'), read.nexus)
names(trees) <- gsub('.trees', '', list.files('../full_output/trees/', pattern = 'r0'))

test_data <- read_csv('../full_output/tsfeatures_treefeatures/test_tsfeatures_treefeatures.csv')
```

```{r}
params_sub <- params %>% 
  filter(param_id %in% c(334, 461, 540, 822, 1335, 1948, 2072, 3384, 4224)) %>% 
  mutate(
    R0_level = cut(
      R0,
      breaks = quantile(R0, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3)),
      labels = str_to_sentence(c("low", "middle", "high")),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    recovery_time_level = cut(
      recovery_time,
      breaks = quantile(recovery_time, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3)),
      labels = str_to_sentence(c("short", "medium", "long")),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
  id = paste0('R<sub>0</sub> = ', round(R0, 2), '<br>D = ', round(recovery_time, 1)),
         R0_level = factor(paste(R0_level, 'R<sub>0</sub>'), levels = paste(str_to_sentence(c("low", "middle", "high")), 'R<sub>0</sub>')),
         recovery_time_level = factor(paste(recovery_time_level, 'D'), levels = paste(str_to_sentence(c("short", "medium", "long")),'D')))
```


## Example case counts and trees

```{r}
ccdat <- case_counts %>% 
  mutate(param_id = as.numeric(gsub('test_p|_r.*', '', sim_id)),
         replicate = as.numeric(gsub('.*_r', '', sim_id))) %>% 
  left_join(params_sub, by = "param_id")

case_counts_plot <- ccdat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = day, y = case_count, color = factor(replicate), group = sim_id)) +
  facet_grid(R0_level ~ recovery_time_level, scales = 'free') +
  geom_line() +
  # geom_text_npc(aes(label = id), npcx = 0.95, npcy = 0.9, check_overlap = TRUE, 
  #                      size = 3, hjust = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_richtext(data = ccdat %>% filter(replicate == 0) %>% group_by(sim_id, R0_level, recovery_time_level, id) %>% summarize(),
                aes(label = id), x = Inf, y = Inf, #check_overlap = TRUE, 
                       size = 3, color = "black",
    fill = NA, label.color = NA) +
  scale_color_grey() +
  labs(x = 'Day', y = 'Case count', color = "Replicate") +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_markdown())
```


```{r}
max_depth <- max(sapply(trees, function(t) max(node.depth.edgelength(t))))

tree_plots <- lapply(names(trees), function(x){
  ggtree(trees[[x]], size = 0.1) + 
    xlim(0, max_depth) 
}) 
names(tree_plots) <- gsub('test_p|_r0', '', names(trees))
tree_plots[[9]] <- tree_plots[[9]] + geom_treescale(x = 300, y = 1000, width = 50, offset = 100, label = 'days', offset.label = -100)

r0_levels <- levels(params_sub$R0_level)
d_levels  <- levels(params_sub$recovery_time_level)

grid_df <- params_sub %>%
    mutate(id_padded = str_pad(param_id, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(plot = list(tree_plots[[id_padded]] + labs(title = NULL))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(depth = max(plot$data$x, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Compute per-column depth (max across rows within each column) ---
col_depths <- grid_df %>%
  group_by(recovery_time_level) %>%
  summarise(col_depth = max(depth), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(recovery_time_level) %>%
  pull(col_depth)

# --- Apply consistent xlim per column so branch lengths stay comparable ---
grid_df <- grid_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    col_idx = as.integer(recovery_time_level),
    plot = list(plot + xlim(0, col_depths[col_idx]))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

make_label <- function(label, angle = 0, size = 3.5) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("richtext", x = 0, y = 0, label = label, angle = angle, size = size, fill = NA, label.color = NA) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +   # <-- allow text to overflow panel bounds
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)) 
}

blank <- plot_spacer()

# --- Column header row (widths match column depths) ---
col_headers <- lapply(d_levels, make_label)
top_row <- wrap_plots(c(list(blank), col_headers, list(blank)),
                       nrow = 1,
                       widths = c(0.05, col_depths, 0.15))

row_headers <- lapply(r0_levels, make_label, angle = -90)

body_rows <- lapply(seq_along(r0_levels), function(i) {
  plots_this_row <- grid_df %>%
    filter(R0_level == r0_levels[i]) %>%
    arrange(recovery_time_level) %>%
    pull(plot)

  wrap_plots(c(list(blank), plots_this_row, list(row_headers[[i]])),
             nrow = 1,
             widths = c(0.05, col_depths, 0.15))
})

tree_plot <- wrap_plots(c(list(top_row), body_rows),
                          ncol = 1, heights = c(0.08, rep(1, length(r0_levels))))
```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=10}
tree_features <- names(test_data)[!grepl('\\.', names(test_data)) & !names(test_data) %in% c('sim_id', 'param_id', 'replicate', 'R0', 'recovery_time', 'total_case_count')]

  pivot_longer(!c(sim_id, param_id, replicate, R0, recovery_time)) %>%

  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(feature_type = case_when(name %in% ts_features ~ 'case counts',
                                  name %in% tree_features ~ 'tree'),
```

### Correlations

```{r}
cors <- test_data_long %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  group_by(feature_type, name) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(R0, recovery_time), names_to = 'parameter_name', values_to = 'parameter_value') %>%
  group_by(parameter_name, feature_type, name) %>% 
  summarize(cor_spearman = cor(parameter_value, value, method = 'spearman'),
            cor_pearson = cor(parameter_value, value, method = 'pearson'))

cors %>% 
  group_by(parameter_name, feature_type) %>% 
  summarize(n_gt8 = sum(abs(cor_spearman) > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE),
            tot = n(),
            prop_gt8 = mean(abs(cor_spearman) > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Reusable function: filter to target-relevant features, 
# then deduplicate correlated features within that set
# ---------------------------------------------------------
select_representative_features <- function(data,
                                             feature_type_filter,
                                             target_vars = c("R0", "recovery_time"),
                                             target_cor_threshold = 0.8,
                                             redundancy_h = 0.2) {

  # --- Step 1: Compute correlation of each feature with each target variable ---
  target_cors <- data %>%
    filter(feature_type == feature_type_filter) %>%
    select(sim_id, name, value_scaled) %>%
    left_join(
      data %>% distinct(sim_id, across(all_of(target_vars))),
      by = "sim_id"
    ) %>%
    group_by(name) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(target_vars),
             ~ abs(cor(value_scaled, .x, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
             .names = "cor_{.col}"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      max_target_cor = max(c_across(starts_with("cor_")), na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_target_cor = mean(c_across(starts_with("cor_")), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # --- Step 2: Keep only features strongly correlated with at least one target ---
  relevant_features <- target_cors %>%
    filter(max_target_cor > target_cor_threshold) %>%
    pull(name)

  message(sprintf("[%s] %d / %d features passed target-correlation filter (>%.2f)",
                   feature_type_filter, length(relevant_features), nrow(target_cors),
                   target_cor_threshold))

  if (length(relevant_features) == 0) {
    warning("No features passed the target correlation threshold.")
    return(list(keep = character(0), relevant = character(0)))
  }

  # --- Step 3: Build feature matrix restricted to relevant features ---
  feature_matrix <- data %>%
    filter(feature_type == feature_type_filter, name %in% relevant_features) %>%
    select(sim_id, name, value_scaled) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value_scaled) %>%
    select(-sim_id)

  # Remove zero-variance columns (safety check)
  feature_matrix <- feature_matrix %>%
    select(where(~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

  # If only one feature survives, no clustering needed
  if (ncol(feature_matrix) <= 1) {
    return(list(keep = colnames(feature_matrix), relevant = relevant_features))
  }

  # --- Step 4: Correlation-based clustering among relevant features only ---
  cor_matrix <- cor(feature_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - abs(cor_matrix))
  hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "average")
  clusters <- cutree(hc, h = redundancy_h)

  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    name = names(clusters),
    cluster = clusters
  )

  # --- Step 5: Pick one representative per cluster (highest target correlation) ---
  representative_features <- cluster_df %>%
    left_join(target_cors, by = "name") %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(max_target_cor, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  list(keep = representative_features$name, relevant = relevant_features)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Apply to 'case counts' and 'tree' feature types
# ---------------------------------------------------------
result_cases <- select_representative_features(
  test_data_long,
  feature_type_filter = "case counts",
  target_vars = c("R0", "recovery_time")
)
keep_features_cases <- result_cases$keep
relevant_features_cases <- result_cases$relevant

result_tree <- select_representative_features(
  test_data_long,
  feature_type_filter = "tree",
  target_vars = c("R0", "recovery_time")
)
keep_features_tree <- result_tree$keep
relevant_features_tree <- result_tree$relevant
```




```{r correlations, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
# --- Full (unfiltered) data: used ONLY to calculate correlation ---
full_df <- test_data_long %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  filter(name %in% c(relevant_features_cases, keep_features_tree) & name != 'number_of_lineages') %>% 
  mutate(name_pretty = prettify_name(name))

# --- Truncated data: used ONLY for plotting hexbins (identical to your original) ---
plot_df <- full_df %>% 
  filter(value_scaled > -3 & value_scaled < 3)

# --- Compute correlation stats manually on FULL data ---
compute_cor_labels <- function(df, x_var, feature_type_val, label_y = 2.6) {
  df %>% 
    filter(feature_type == feature_type_val) %>% 
    group_by(name_pretty) %>% 
    summarise(
      rho = cor(.data[[x_var]], value_scaled, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
      x_pos = min(.data[[x_var]], na.rm = TRUE),   # anchor near left edge of data
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      label = paste0("rho == ", formatC(signif(rho, 2), digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")),
      y_pos = label_y  
    )
}

# --- Panel builder ---
make_panel <- function(display_df, corr_df, x_var, x_label, feature_type_val) {
  
  panel_data <- display_df %>% filter(feature_type == feature_type_val)
  cor_labels <- compute_cor_labels(corr_df, x_var, feature_type_val)
  
  ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = value_scaled)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 30) +   # explicit bins, keeps binning consistent
    geom_text(
      data = cor_labels,
      aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label),
      parse = TRUE,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
    facet_grid(~ name_pretty, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty()) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'A', direction = -1,
                          breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3), limits = c(0, 2500)) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = 'Scaled feature value', fill = 'Number of simulations')
}

# Build panels
p_D_case  <- make_panel(plot_df, full_df, "recovery_time", "D",   "case counts")
p_D_tree  <- make_panel(plot_df, full_df, "recovery_time", "D",   "tree")
p_R0_case <- make_panel(plot_df, full_df, "R0",             "R0", "case counts")
p_R0_tree <- make_panel(plot_df, full_df, "R0",             "R0", "tree")

ggarrange(
  p_D_case +
    theme(plot.margin = unit(c(20,5.5,5.5,5.5), units = 'pt')),
  p_D_tree + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                   axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                   plot.margin = unit(c(20,5.5,5.5,5.5), units = 'pt')),
  p_R0_case + 
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(x = 'R<sub>0</sub>') +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_markdown()), 
  p_R0_tree + scale_x_log10() + 
    labs(x = 'R<sub>0</sub>') +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          strip.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_markdown()),
  common.legend = TRUE,
  labels = c('A Case counts', 'B Tree', '', ''), 
  label.x = c(-0.02, -0.02),
  legend = 'bottom',
  heights = c(1.25, 1),
  widths = c(3, 4)
)
```


### Tables

```{r}
# Regenerates Table 1 (case-count features) and Table 2 (tree features)
# directly from the `dput()` correlation tibble -- no manual transcription.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Metadata: map internal feature name -> category, display label, fn call
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

case_meta <- tribble(
  ~name, ~category, ~display, ~fn, ~order,

  # --- Autocorrelation & Stationarity ---
  "acf_features_x_acf1",                 "Autocorrelation & Stationarity", "ACF (Lag 1)",                   "acf\\_features()",      1,
  "acf_features_x_acf10",                "Autocorrelation & Stationarity", "ACF (Lags 1-10)",               "acf\\_features()",      2,
  "acf_features_diff1_acf1",             "Autocorrelation & Stationarity", "ACF (1st Diff, Lag 1)",         "acf\\_features()",      3,
  "acf_features_diff1_acf10",            "Autocorrelation & Stationarity", "ACF (1st Diff, Lags 1-10)",     "acf\\_features()",      4,

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build a wide table: one row per feature, R0 and D spearman correlations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_table <- function(df, meta, feature_type_filter, cat_order) {
  wide <- df %>%
    filter(feature_type == feature_type_filter) %>%
    select(parameter_name, name, cor_spearman) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = parameter_name, values_from = cor_spearman)

  out <- meta %>%
    left_join(wide, by = "name") %>%
    mutate(
      category = factor(category, levels = cat_order),
      R0 = sprintf("%.2f", R0),
      D  = sprintf("%.2f", recovery_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(category, order) %>%
    select(name, category, display, fn, R0, D)

  # sanity check: flag any metadata row that failed to join (no match in df)
  missing <- out %>% filter(is.na(R0) | R0 == "NA")
  if (nrow(missing) > 0) {
    warning("Unmatched feature names (check spelling against df$name):\n",
            paste(missing$name, collapse = ", "))
  }

  out
}

case_tbl <- build_table(cors, case_meta, "case counts", cat_order_case)
tree_tbl <- build_table(cors, tree_meta, "tree",        cat_order_tree)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Emit LaTeX with kableExtra (pack_rows recreates the multirow category
#    grouping seen in Table S1 / S2)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_latex <- function(tbl, caption, label) {
  n_features <- nrow(tbl)
  k <- kbl(
    tbl %>% select(display, fn, R0, D),
    format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
    caption = caption, label = label,
    col.names = c("Feature", "Function", "$R_0$", "$D$"),
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r")
  )
  grp_sizes <- tbl %>% count(category, .drop = FALSE) %>% filter(n > 0)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grp_sizes))) {
    start <- sum(grp_sizes$n[seq_len(i - 1)]) + 1
    end   <- sum(grp_sizes$n[seq_len(i)])
    k <- pack_rows(k, as.character(grp_sizes$category[i]), start, end)
  }
  k <- footnote(k, general = paste0("Total number of features: ", n_features),
                general_title = "", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
  k
}

latex_case <- make_latex(case_tbl, "Spearman correlation of case count features with parameters", "tab:tsfeatures")
latex_tree <- make_latex(tree_tbl, "Spearman correlation of tree features with parameters", "tab:treefeatures")

writeLines(latex_case, "table_S1_case_counts.tex")
writeLines(latex_tree, "table_S2_tree_features.tex")

cat("Tables written:\n  table_S1_case_counts.tex\n  table_S2_tree_features.tex\n")
```
